stem:
Facts:
1. The evacuation center can hold 300 people.
2. Sitio Malinis has 120 families, with an average of 4 people per family.
3. During a strong typhoon, all residents of Sitio Malinis must go to an evacuation center.

Which conclusion follows from the facts?
choices: The sitio will need exactly two evacuation centers.
Most families in the sitio have exactly 4 members.
A strong typhoon will hit Sitio Malinis this year.
The center cannot hold all of the sitio's residents.
answer: The center cannot hold all of the sitio's residents.
hints: An average of 4 people per family lets you find the total number of residents.
Multiply the number of families by the average: 120 × 4.
Compare the total number of residents with what the center can hold. Then throw out choices that need facts you were not given, or that misread what an average means.

solution.methodName: Facts-only test: keep only what the facts prove

steps.action: Find the total number of residents: 120 families × 4 people = 480 people.
steps.why: Multiplying an average by the number of families gives the total, even though each family may have a different size.

steps.action: Compare: 480 people need shelter, but the center holds only 300.
480 is more than 300, so the center cannot hold all of the sitio's residents.

Check the others. The facts do not say how big other centers are, so "exactly two" is not supported. An average of 4 does not mean most families have exactly 4. Nothing says a typhoon will come this year.
The conclusion that follows: The center cannot hold all of the sitio's residents.

trapNotes.The sitio will need exactly two evacuati: Other evacuation centers may be bigger or smaller than this one. The facts do not say how many centers the sitio will need.
trapNotes.Most families in the sitio have exactly: An average is not the most common size. Families of 2 and 6 also average 4. The facts do not tell you how many families have exactly 4.
trapNotes.A strong typhoon will hit Sitio Malinis: The facts only say what residents must do if a strong typhoon comes. They never say one will come this year.
